propositions: Define and maintain a documentation ownership policy that distinguishes durable records, maintained documentation, shipped help, comments, generated artifacts, and protected evidence across eight documentation roles.
Restore writing rules and protected forms guidance as author-facing recommendations without introducing deterministic character, word, punctuation, or prose validators or enforcement gates.
Consolidate generated-artifact inventory in docs/generated-artifacts.md and repoint all consumers from docs/README.md while preserving catalog entries, regeneration commands, and enforcement gates.

Establish policy pointers in AGENTS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, and docs/README.md that direct users to the ownership, correction, and writing guidance without describing the guidance as a deterministic gate.
Preserve ticket events as append-only and ADR decision substance through annotations, errata, or replacement ADRs without editing historical evidence or protected evidence.
Retain all existing structural, generated-artifact, link, and comment-hygiene gates while adding no new hooks, tests, CI gates, or runtime rejection based on writing guidance.
